text:
Jamie Benn got his 1,000th career point last night, and Jake Oettinger made it a full evening in Dallas with a 22-save shutout of Buffalo. The Stars have barely had time to put the puck in a case. The Panthers come in on the second night of a back-to-back too, fresh from a 4-1 win in St. Louis on the night the Blues honoured Keith Tkachuk with both of his sons in the building.

Matthew Tkachuk could have his own round number tonight. He is one point from 700 for his career, on a seven-game point streak that is all assists (nine of them). Sam Reinhart reached 700 two nights ago and has goals in three straight games. Florida has won three in a row without Aleksander Barkov and Brad Marchand, both on injured reserve with knee injuries. Since they went out, Matthew Tkachuk has moved in beside Reinhart and his brother Brady, and Lars Eller is playing 16 and a half minutes a night, up from about 13.

Dallas has its own hole on the back end. Miro Heiskanen (upper body) is out, with ESPN estimating a return on Tuesday. Thomas Harley has taken over the top power-play unit, and Tyler Myers is up to 20:35 a night from 17:10.

At five on five the two teams have been close to even: both have taken 52% of the expected goals, the quality of chances, in their games. The likeliest gap is in the penalty box. Florida takes 5.4 penalties a game, and its penalty kill gives up 0.85 expected goals a night, more than the Dallas power play usually creates. Both backups are projected to start, Akira Schmid for Florida and Casey DeSmith for Dallas, and both sit just under average in saves above expected. Our numbers give Dallas a slightly better night of chances (3.09 expected goals to 2.94). Both teams were in action last night, so the back-to-back balances out.
headline: Benn's milestone night gives way to a Florida visit
